info.name: Sprint 14 - JWT, registro, login y APIs protegidas

item.name: 001 - Mascotas sin token, antes de autenticarse

exec: pm.test("Respuesta contiene \u00fanicamente el token", () => { pm.expect(Object.keys(pm.response.json())).to.eql(["token"]); const token=pm.response.json().token; pm.expect(typeof token).to.eql("string"); pm.expect(token.split(".").length).to.eql(3); pm.collectionVariables.set("jwt",token); });

pm.test("HS256, identidad, rol y expiraci\u00f3n de 24 horas", () => { const token=pm.response.json().token; const header=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token.split(".")[0],"base64").toString()); const claims=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token.split(".")[1],"base64").toString()); pm.expect(header.alg).to.eql("HS256"); pm.expect(claims.rol).to.eql("ADMIN"); pm.expect(claims.exp-claims.iat).to.eql(86400); pm.expect(claims).not.to.have.property("password"); });

026 - Identidad falsa sin token no autentica

exec: pm.test("Gateway y configuraci\u00f3n UP", () => { const health=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(health.status).to.eql("UP"); pm.expect(health.components.clientConfigServer.status).to.eql("UP"); pm.expect(health.components).not.to.have.property("db"); });

pm.test("Gateway y cuatro APIs UP", () => { const apps=[].concat(pm.response.json().applications.application); for (const name of ["API-GATEWAY","MS-AUTH","MS-DUENO","MS-MASCOTA","MS-VETERINARIO","MS-TURNO"]) pm.expect(apps.some(a => a.name===name && [].concat(a.instance).some(i => i.status==="UP"))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("Rutas y CORS desde Git", () => { const data=pm.response.json(); const p=data.propertySources.find(s => s.name.endsWith("/api-gateway.yml")).source; pm.expect(data.version).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/); pm.expect(p["server.port"]).to.eql(8080); pm.expect(p["spring.cloud.gateway.server.webflux.discovery.locator.enabled"]).to.eql(true); pm.expect(p["management.endpoint.gateway.access"]).to.eql("read-only"); });

pm.test("Cuatro rutas lb y alias", () => { const routes=pm.response.json(); for (const slug of ["dueno","mascota","veterinario","turno"]) { const route=routes.find(r => r.route_id==="ms-"+slug); pm.expect(route.uri).to.eql("lb://ms-"+slug); } pm.expect(routes.some(r => r.route_id==="ms-dueno-v1")).to.eql(true); pm.expect(routes.filter(r => r.route_id.includes("DiscoveryClient")).length).to.eql(3); pm.expect(routes.length).to.eql(9); });

item.name: 110 - Configuración centralizada de Circuit Breaker y Retry

exec: pm.test("Dos circuitos con parámetros de la consigna", () => { const p=pm.response.json().propertySources.find(s => s.name.endsWith("/ms-turno.yml")).source; for (const name of ["mascotaService","veterinarioService"]) { const prefix="resilience4j.circuitbreaker.instances."+name+"."; pm.expect(p[prefix+"slidingWindowSize"]).to.eql(10); pm.expect(p[prefix+"minimumNumberOfCalls"]).to.eql(5); pm.expect(p[prefix+"failureRateThreshold"]).to.eql(50); pm.expect(p[prefix+"waitDurationInOpenState"]).to.eql("10s"); pm.expect(p[prefix+"permittedNumberOfCallsInHalfOpenState"]).to.eql(3); pm.expect(p[prefix+"automaticTransitionFromOpenToHalfOpenEnabled"]).to.eql(true); } });

pm.test("Tres intentos con backoff progresivo y Circuit Breaker exterior", () => { const p=pm.response.json().propertySources.find(s => s.name.endsWith("/ms-turno.yml")).source; for (const name of ["mascotaService","veterinarioService"]) { const prefix="resilience4j.retry.instances."+name+"."; pm.expect(p[prefix+"maxAttempts"]).to.eql(3); pm.expect(p[prefix+"waitDuration"]).to.eql("1s"); pm.expect(p[prefix+"enableExponentialBackoff"]).to.eql(true); pm.expect(p[prefix+"exponentialBackoffMultiplier"]).to.eql(2); pm.expect(p[prefix+"retryExceptionPredicate"]).to.include("RemoteCallRetryPredicate"); } pm.expect(p["resilience4j.circuitbreaker.circuitBreakerAspectOrder"]).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p["resilience4j.retry.retryAspectOrder"]).to.eql(2); });

item.name: 111 - Configuración de Redis y cuota de Turnos

exec: pm.test("Token bucket 10 por segundo, capacidad 20 y costo 1", () => { const p=pm.response.json().propertySources.find(s => s.name.endsWith("/api-gateway.yml")).source; const value=suffix => Object.entries(p).find(([key]) => key.endsWith(suffix))[1]; pm.expect(value("redis-rate-limiter.replenishRate")).to.eql(10); pm.expect(value("redis-rate-limiter.burstCapacity")).to.eql(20); pm.expect(value("redis-rate-limiter.requestedTokens")).to.eql(1); pm.expect(value("key-resolver")).to.eql("#{@clientIpKeyResolver}"); pm.expect(p["spring.data.redis.port"]).to.eql("${REDIS_PORT:6379}"); });

item.name: 116 - Retry no reintenta los 404 de negocio

exec: pm.test("Sin reintentos de recursos inexistentes", () => { const started=Date.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("resilienceVerificationStarted")); const events=pm.response.json().retryEvents.filter(e => Date.parse(e.creationTime.split("[")[0])>=started); pm.expect(events).to.eql([]); });
